payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Change the image into pencil drawing
requirements.source_phrase: Change the image into pencil drawing

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.
outcomes.target: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented in a pencil-drawn style.
outcomes.reference: The supplied image and the requested pencil-drawing transformation.

response.content: {"decisions":[{"requirement_id":"R1","question":"Is the image rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented in a pencil-drawn style?","criteria":"Pass if the image is transformed into a pencil-drawing style; fail if it remains in its original style with no pencil-drawing transformation; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine whether the transformation was made.","binding":"Compare the supplied image with the requested pencil-drawing transformation; judge the visible rendering of its visual content."}]}

decisions.question: Is the image rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented in a pencil-drawn style?
decisions.criteria: Pass if the image is transformed into a pencil-drawing style; fail if it remains in its original style with no pencil-drawing transformation; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine whether the transformation was made.
decisions.binding: Compare the supplied image with the requested pencil-drawing transformation; judge the visible rendering of its visual content.
